settings.label: Logo image
settings.info: Optional. If left blank, the shop name is shown as a wordmark ("ARDEA."), matching the ARDEA demo.

settings.label: Favicon image
settings.info: Will be scaled down to 32 x 32px

settings.content: These default to the fixed ARDEA brand tokens (Sand / Terracotta / Deep Olive / Charcoal Brown / Cream) used throughout the master design. Adjust only if you intend to depart from the brand guidelines.

settings.label: Heading font
settings.info: Defaults to Fraunces, matching the ARDEA demo's warm editorial serif.

settings.label: Body / UI font
settings.info: Defaults to Manrope, matching the ARDEA demo.

settings.label: Free delivery threshold
settings.info: Amount (in your shop's currency major units) at which the free-delivery progress bar in the cart drawer/cart page reaches 100%. The ARDEA demo uses ₹6,000. Shopify's own shop currency setting (Settings > General) governs how amounts actually display at checkout; this setting only drives the visual progress bar.

settings.label: Use cart drawer
settings.info: When enabled, adding a product opens the slide-in cart drawer, matching the demo. The dedicated cart page (/cart) is always available.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: Ardea designs modern furniture and home decor for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and lighting — solid oak, linen and stone, made to be lived in.
settings.info: Used as a fallback on any page that has no page-specific description (product/collection descriptions are preferred automatically when present).

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Used for Open Graph / Twitter previews when a page has no more specific image (e.g. no product/collection image).

settings.content: Shopify has no native wishlist object. Wishlist state is stored client-side in the shopper's browser via localStorage, keyed by product handle (see assets/theme.js, ArdeaWishlist). It is per-browser, not synced to the customer account.
